provenance.cached_initializer: Saved XDF_selected rank14 is byte-identical to R14_before and component-identical to original tol1e-8,max_vecs14 explicit-Cholesky initializer; compare again with full XDF prefix. Return copies in one dedicated-process ffsim initialization binding; no new decomposition.

optimizer_note: Old H6 caller omitted options/callback: both None. ffsim tol controls XDF truncation; do not add scipy.minimize tol or options. Existing fixed loss .5||g-g_DF||F^2, analytic JAX x64 gradient, and unchanged unpack retained.

call_definition.saved_fit_load: One read of fixed g, saved XDF14 and full XDF (prepare worker)
call_definition.saved_initial_identity: One component identity check including column signs/rank/order against XDF_full[:14]
call_definition.corrected_codec: One saved J/U real-Schur/gauge pack-unpack and all frame/J/projector/tensor fidelity gates before sector qualification
call_definition.tensor_assessment: Two saved-before and restored-initial tensor F/max/objective diagnostics
call_definition.fit_input_load: One reload of same fixed g/J/U and qualified x0 in isolated fit worker
call_definition.optimized_fitter: At most one ffsim.linalg.double_factorized(optimize=True) invocation, including cached initializer, one additional corrected-codec pack/x0 identity check, original L-BFGS-B iterations/internal value-gradient calls, original final unpack. Cached initializer used once, new Cholesky decompositions0. No optimizer algorithm reimplementation.
call_definition.initial_value_gradient: One diagnostic of the actual scipy_func at x0 before original minimize, includes finite/objective check and exact x0/gradient export
call_definition.final_value_gradient: One diagnostic of same actual scipy_func at optimizer-returned x before final unpack, includes comparison with returned fun and raw jac export
call_definition.final_tensor_assessment: One tensor F/max/objective plus schema/orthogonality check of returned J/U
call_definition.optimizer_objective_check: One returned optimizer fun vs returned J/U tensor objective check
call_definition.snapshots_load: Two parent reads: original h/g/c plus before/initial exports; then final fit J/U
call_definition.physical_sector: One original physical h/g/c sparse Hamiltonian restricted/densified sector400, reused
call_definition.sector_assessment: Three existing rank_assessment calls: saved before, restored qualified x0, final fit; unchanged original-g kappa/scalar/ordered frames and engineering guard
call_definition.initial_equivalence_budget_gate: One sector component check1e-10, reported operator-difference spectral norm, before/initial norm+guard<=CA/8; must pass before fit worker
call_definition.final_decision: Separate optimizer success and final norm+guard budget judgment; signed tensor and sector changes from x0; no automatic initial fallback

counted_units_note: 5 prepare + 6 fit + 9 parent =20 max. The single fit is one logical unit irrespective of iteration count, including its internal optimizer calls; two explicit diagnostic value-gradient calls are separately counted. Max corrected-codec packs2, optimizer invocations1, new initial decompositions0. Record actual nfev/njev/nit. Fewer units on early STOP.
execution_order: Separate chat permission for this fixed SOURCE/input/contract/fresh output; current work is technical only
Passive preflight, actual resources, prepare worker saved identity+codec+tensor gates (no optimizer)
Parent creates sector400 context/physical once, assesses before+initial, sector equivalence and initial budget gate
One isolated fit worker: cached saved XDF14 -> corrected pack -> exact qualified x0 check -> actual scipy_func initial value/gradient -> original L-BFGS-B
Preserve actual optimizer result x/jac/status/message/fun/nit/nfev/njev, final value-gradient and unpack/tensor check
Reuse parent physical sector/context for final error+guard, independent optimizer/budget judgments and point changes
Save partial/full evidence/resources/calls, publish/remote verify, mandatory STOP

STOP.identity_codec_nonfinite_or_objective_mi: STOP immediately, no legacy fallback or dependent calculations; save partial evidence
STOP.initial_budget_fail: STOP before fit; no change to rank/conditions/guard
STOP.optimizer_exception: STOP with partial evidence, no retry/resume/extra fit
STOP.optimizer_unsuccessful_return: Preserve finite returned state and finish explicitly registered final tensor/sector diagnostics, record optimizer success=false independently of budget; then STOP
STOP.final_budget_fail: Record NOT_MET even if optimizer success=true, never adopt initial state automatically; STOP

preservation: Old H6 failed fits and all H2/H4 SOURCE/raw results/grants/ledgers/markers/STOP immutable. Only fresh task output, never restart old runner.
qualification: Numerical pilot with unchanged engineering guard, not a rigorous enclosure, CA achievement or resource superiority. Codec round-trip success does not imply optimizer success or final budget retention.
performance: Sparse CAR and sector400 only; reuse physical Hamiltonian/context. Parallelize two independent initial sector assessments from resource_plan and coordinate local BLAS; one L-BFGS-B fit uses existing JAX x64 loss/gradient. Check actual available CPU/RAM first, yield own job on contention. No arbitrary CPU/RAM/worker/wall cap; no shared environment/other-user changes.
permission_policy: Separate explicit chat permission required for new fit; no approval proof/record/certificate/new grant.
